basic_details.job_title: ICAR-IIHR CHES Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Under the project "Development of DUS Test guidelines for Rambutan (Naphelium lappaceum L.)", the Central Horticultural Experiment Station (CHES), Chettalli, Kodagu, of ICAR-Indian Institute of Horticultural Research has invited applications for one temporary Senior Research Fellow post at Rs. 42,000/- + 10% HRA up to 2027-28. The essential qualification is M.Sc. in Agriculture / Horticulture / Botany. Applications must be sent in the prescribed proforma by post and reach the CHES office by 24 November 2026, 5.00 p.m. (email applications are not accepted). The personal interview is on 1 Decemb

how_to_apply: Fill in the application in the prescribed proforma ("Application Format", printed with the notice). It asks for personal details, educational qualifications, whether NET qualified, whether pursuing Ph.D., experience and publications. It needs a recent passport size photograph and the candidate's signature.
Write the Item No. and the name of the post clearly on the application and on the envelope. The notice says the application is likely to be rejected otherwise.
Attach attested copies of the educational / technical qualifications and the experience certificate.
Send the application to: Office, Senior Scientist & The Head(I/c), ICAR-Central Horticultural Experiment Station, Chettalli, Kodagu-571 248.
Make sure it reaches the office by 24 November 2026, 5.00 p.m. Applications received after the due date, including because of postal delays, will not be entertained.

Applications that are not in the prescribed proforma, are incomplete or unsigned, lack the project name, photo or Item No., or are ONLINE applications are liable to be rejected. Email applications will not be accepted. For clarifications, the notice gives the numbers 7892882351 and 9005847283 and the email [email protected].
SSLC marks card / Date of birth certificate proof
First page of the publications, if any
No Objection Certificate from the concerned PI, for in-service SRF, JRF, YP's, Field Worker and other contractual staff engaged under schemes / projects at this Institute
important_instructions: Eligible candidates must bring all educational / technical qualification certificates, Date of Birth and experience certificates in original, plus two recent passport size photographs, for verification. Candidates without original or provisional educational qualification certificates will not be allowed to attend the interview. Candidates who are not present at the Institute campus by 9.00 AM on 1 December 2026 will not be allowed to attend the interview. Vacancies may increase or decrease as per the requirement of the Institute. The Director, ICAR-IIHR reserves the right to fill all the posts or any of them without assigning any reasons. The declaration in the application form says that the candidate has never been punished or debarred from government (central/state) autonomous organisations and ICAR service, and has not been convicted by a court of law for any offence.

content_sections.heading: About the Centre
content_sections.text: The Central Horticultural Experiment Station, Chettalli (Kodagu, Karnataka) works under ICAR-Indian Institute of Horticultural Research. The Director, ICAR-IIHR, Bengaluru, has invited the applications, and the notice is signed by the Head, CHES, Chettalli. The post is for the project on DUS Test guidelines for Rambutan.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice also says "Eligible candidate between the age group of 23-40 years may apply" in its introduction, while the "Other Terms and Condition" section gives 35 years for men and 40 years for women. The post's own limit is given above. No age relaxation is listed in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is Rs. 42,000/- + 10% HRA up to 2027-28. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The period and duration of the scheme is tentative and may change. ICAR/IIHR has no liability for absorption of the appointee at the Institute. On reporting, the selected candidate has to deposit a sum equal to one month's remuneration as a "refundable caution deposit". No TA/DA is paid to RA, SRF, JRF, YP's, Project Associate and Field Worker attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-IIHR CHES Senior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Fill in the application in the prescribed proforma ("Application Format", printed with the notice). It asks for personal details, educational qualifications, whether NET qualified, whether pursuing Ph.D., experience and publications. It needs a recent passport size photograph and the candidate's signature. Write the Item No. and the name of the post clearly on the application and on the envelope. The notice says the application is likely to be rejected otherwise. Attach attested copies of the educational / technical qualifications and the experience certificate. Send the application to: Office, Senior Scientist & The Head(I/c), ICAR-Central Horticultural Experiment Station, Chettalli, Kodagu-571 248. Make sure it reaches the office by 24 November 2026, 5.00 p.m. Applications received after the due date, including because of postal delays, will not be entertained. Applications that are not in the prescribed proforma, are incomplete or unsigned, lack the project name, photo or Item No., or are ONLINE applications are liable to be rejected. Email applications will not be accepted. For clarifications, the notice gives the numbers 7892882351 and 9005847283 and the email [email protected] . Application form SSLC marks card / Date of birth certificate proof SC/ST/OBC certificate, if any Degree certificates and marks cards First page of the publications, if any Experience certificate No Objection Certificate from the concerned PI, for in-service SRF, JRF, YP's, Field Worker and other contractual staff engaged under schemes / projects at this Institute

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through a personal interview. The applications received are screened, and only shortlisted candidates face a panel / personal interview. The list of eligible candidates for the interview will be displayed on the ICAR-IIHR website, and no separate call letters will be sent. Any change in selection or the interview schedule will be notified on the Institute's website only. The interview will be held from 10.00 A.M. onwards on 1 December 2026 at the CHES, Chettalli office. Only candidates whose duly filled applications arrive before the due date are permitted to take part. A wait-listed candidate in the reserve panel may be engaged for another project with the approval of the C.A.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Research Fellow posts are there at ICAR-IIHR CHES, Chettalli?
faq.answer: There is 1 Senior Research Fellow post under the project "Development of DUS Test guidelines for Rambutan". The notice says vacancies may increase or decrease as per the Institute's requirement.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR-IIHR CHES SRF post?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the CHES, Chettalli office by 24 November 2026, 5.00 p.m. Applications received after that date, including those delayed by post, will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the ICAR-IIHR CHES Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is M.Sc. in Agriculture / Horticulture / Botany. M.Sc. in Fruit Science and experience in Fruit Science are desirable. The degree must be from an accredited, UGC recognised university.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ICAR-IIHR CHES Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The age limit given under the post is 35 years for men and 40 years for women. The notice's introduction mentions the age group 23-40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Senior Research Fellow at ICAR-IIHR CHES?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 42,000/- + 10% HRA up to 2027-28.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the ICAR-IIHR CHES Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Send the duly filled application in the prescribed proforma, with attested certificates and the experience certificate, to the Senior Scientist & The Head(I/c), ICAR-Central Horticultural Experiment Station, Chettalli, Kodagu-571 248, so that it reaches by 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply by email or online for the ICAR-IIHR CHES SRF post?
faq.answer: No. The notice says email applications will not be accepted, and ONLINE applications are liable to be rejected.

faq.question: Q8. How is the Senior Research Fellow selected at ICAR-IIHR CHES?
faq.answer: Selection is through a personal interview. Applications are screened first, and only shortlisted candidates are interviewed on 1 December 2026 at the CHES, Chettalli office.

faq.question: Q9. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 42,000 remuneration?
faq.answer: Yes. The remuneration is printed as Rs. 42,000/- + 10% HRA up to 2027-28.

faq.question: Q10. Is the ICAR-IIHR CHES Senior Research Fellow job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, and ICAR/IIHR has no liability for absorption at the Institute. A refundable caution deposit equal to one month's remuneration is to be paid on reporting.
